Draws the patient timeline, the paper's Supplemental Figure 1, as a static image and as an interactive page, both saved to the gitignored `figures/` folder.

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/figures.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/figures.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/functions.R)
-   [`R/load_data.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/load_data.R)
-   [`R/process_offers.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/hope-act-education-intervention/blob/master/R/process_offers.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/figures.R")
```

## Follow-up

Days from day 0 to each candidate's consent and end of follow-up. Each is moved by its own random shift of up to two days, never across day 0, so the figure is no more precise than the published static one; the interactive page embeds every plotted value, which is why the shift comes before plotting. The end of follow-up is one event, so its shifted day is used for both the end of the line and the end marker.

```{r}
#| label: timeline-follow-up
#| eval: false
```

## Events

Offers, as declined, accepted but not transplanted, or accepted and transplanted, each at its own shifted day; and how follow-up ended for candidates not transplanted from a donor with HIV.

```{r}
#| label: timeline-events
#| eval: false
```

## Lines

Each candidate's follow-up as up to two segments split at day 0: red before the intervention and blue after, as in the original code.

```{r}
#| label: timeline-lines
#| eval: false
```

## Plot

The original figure's layers and styling. A candidate followed only before, or only after, day 0 has no segment on the other side; it is dropped without a warning.

```{r}
#| label: timeline-plot
#| eval: false
```

## Export

A PNG image and a self-contained interactive page in `figures/`, which stays out of Git until the figure is cleared.

#| label: save-timeline
